text: The retired show_folder_pane changed folderPaneBox in the shared top-level mc document. Current get_about_3pane resolves the selected mail3PaneTab’s embedded window. restoreState controls folderPaneSplitter.isCollapsed; its undefined visibility default shows the pane when a folder URI exists or no synthetic view is being restored, and the splitter is disabled for a synthetic view. cmd_toggleFolderPane operates on that splitter and is enabled when gFolder exists. Use this current owner rather than resurrecting the deleted top-document helper; layout interaction was not executed. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.
title: Folder-pane visibility belongs to the current about3Pane layout owner
